extDescription.message: Dark mode for websites that don't have one. Dark, sepia and grayscale, with brightness and warmth controls for night reading.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store summary shown under the item name. HARD LIMIT 132 characters in every locale.

modeOff.description: Mode tile label. Keep under ~10 characters — it sits in a narrow 4-column grid.

modeDark.description: Mode tile label. Keep short, see modeOff.

modeSepia.description: Mode tile label. Keep short, see modeOff.

modeGrayscale.description: Mode tile label. Keep short, see modeOff.

controlWarmth.description: Slider label. Adds a sepia tint to cut blue light; not literally 'temperature'.

hintContrast.description: Tooltip. Lowering contrast lifts pure black towards grey and takes the glare off white text.

noticeUnsupported.message: This page can't be themed by extensions.

noticeTabError.message: Could not read the current tab.

noticeSaveFailed.message: Could not save your preference. Please try again.

pillAlreadyDark.description: Badge in the popup header. Very short — under 16 characters.

pillAlreadyDarkTitle.message: This site is rendering its own dark theme

pillHasDarkTheme.description: Badge in the popup header. Very short — under 16 characters.

pillHasDarkThemeTitle.message: This site ships its own dark theme. Its own setting will look better than a colour filter.

noticeAlreadyDark.message: This page is already dark. Inverting it will turn it light — Off usually looks better here.
noticeAlreadyDark.description: Shown when the user has Dark switched on over a page that is already dark.

badgeTitleAlreadyDark.message: Dark Mode Enabler — this site already has its own dark theme
